Attached is the updated pricing table (sheet 2) in AST_pricing_model_v2.xlsx. Quick summary:

- Option 1 (recommended for cost efficiency): 24-month retainer with 60% prepay in year1, 40% in year2. Effective blended discount ~28% vs list (year1 effective ~32% when applied to anticipated ramp). We can include a $25k onboarding credit applied against the first invoice.

If procurement wants a lower-year1 effective TCO we can increase the onboarding credit and shift more savings into year1, but that reduces Redwood's margin. For program approvals I anticipate needing a margin exception for Option 1 at the level discussed.

Next step: if AstraMed is comfortable with Option 1 + onboarding credit, I will request formal approval from finance/leadership and push the DocuSign path.

Cheers,
